correctness.rationale: For f(n)=floor(μ−rn), integer adjacent differences are −1 or 0; composing yields g(n+1)−g(n)∈{0,1} and h(n)=g(n)−n nonincreasing by steps 0 or −1. The exact rounding defects ε_n=μ−rn−f(n)∈[0,1) give g(n)=r²n+(1−r)μ+r ε_n−ε_{f(n)}; hence h changes sign at infinity and, with unit steps, has a nonempty consecutive finite zero interval [L,U]. Monotonicity rules out overshoot; exterior g-orbits strictly approach and attain their nearer endpoint. f permutes finite fixed core and reverses its order, giving f(j)=L+U−j. The half-open real first-step cells ((μ−j−1)/r,(μ−j)/r] yield exact disjoint basins incl all boundary ties. Uniform additive error |g^k(n)−r^{2k}n|≤C gives τ(n)=log|n|/(−2log r)+O_{r,μ}(1) from lower exclusion and finite-state upper capture. The bundled rational checker was read, not executed; no finite result is infinite proof.
